title: The drawer
body: The drawer beside the roster desk has no handle. It has never needed one. The lock is a clearance, and yours now clears it. You pull, and the drawer comes out like a breath held too long. Inside: one folder. PATCH NOTES, WEEK 41. The staples are warm.

outcome.text: The folder opens. The pages are numbered the way a city would number its weeks: 41, 41, 41.
You close it. The drawer settles, satisfied, like a mouth that has been fed a secret. You will be back. The drawer knows you will be back.
